title: Humidity Sensor Error
shortDescription: Room humidity sensor reporting invalid values.
fullDescription:
E1 occurs when the RH sensor fails self-test. The dehumidifier cannot regulate output without a valid sensor.

Power cycle first; if persistent, replace sensor module.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Open top cover, reseat sensor plug.

title: Coil Temperature Sensor Error
fullDescription: E2 means the coil sensor is open or shorted. Without it, defrost cycles cannot run reliably.

title: Frost / Defrost Error
fullDescription:
E3 fires when defrost cycles do not clear frost from the coil, usually because ambient temperature is too low.

Move to a warmer room (above 41F) or let unit thaw.

title: Bucket Full
fullDescription: E4 indicates the bucket float has tripped. Empty and reseat bucket.

faq.a: Yes, connect hose for continuous drain.

title: Compressor Error
fullDescription: E5 reports compressor overload or start failure. Wait 10 minutes, then retry. Persistent E5 requires pro diagnosis.

title: Fan Motor Error
fullDescription: E6 indicates fan motor failure or obstruction. Clean filter and inspect fan.

title: High Temperature Alarm
fullDescription: E7 means interior temperature exceeded safe limit. Check for blocked vents or high ambient.

faq.a: Unit self-protects but underlying cause must be found.

title: Communication Error
fullDescription: E8 indicates UI and main board cannot communicate. Power cycle, then reseat connections.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Open UI and reseat ribbon cable.
